node.title: E1 profile-(2,10) cofactor-1538 collision exclusion
node.closure: sharp moment envelope, finite-field orbit screen, and exact real-cyclotomic norms
node.statement: No binding-row profile-(2,10,S=18) collision has cofactor 1538. The sharp moment envelope forces V<=4; V=0,2 are impossible, and the V=4 branch reduces to five Galois types whose exact real-cyclotomic norm quotients all lie below the prize field floor. Hence the profile envelope drops from 394 to 266 shift/sign orbits and from 100864 to 68096 oriented vectors.
node.notes: EXACT SPLIT-PRIME EXCLUSION 2026-07-29: a 640-hit finite-field screen over all primitive roots modulo 769 canonicalizes to five types. Stdlib Bareiss determinants recompute all five degree-64 norms. No support-vector enumeration, heuristic primality, E1 close, or Prize movement. The remaining split cofactors are 514 and 1028 above 257.
